verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers a CLI for running tests/collections and an MCP server that lets an agent read/change collections, requests, environments and teams and send real HTTP requests, giving substantial API-driven parity with UI actions. However, there is no evidence of a general public REST/OpenAPI API (probe explicitly found 404s for openapi.json/swagger.json), so many UI actions (e.g., managing headers/auth inheritance, request variables, client certs, admin dashboard config, OAuth/SSO setup) have no documented programmatic equivalent. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose REST/OpenAPI API covering all UI features, evidence that CLI/MCP cover admin/config/SSO/cert management, and independent confirmation that CLI+MCP together achieve full UI parity.
